content.text: The letter reports the portfolio's own returns (net, gross, YTD, since-inception) but never mentions the comparison index at all — there is no reference to the Global All-Cap Equity Index or its 2.47% Q3 2026 return anywhere in the text. The omission is notable because it removes the only benchmark against which the -0.86% net quarterly result could be read.

points.evidence: The letter's performance paragraph states only: "your portfolio returned -0.86% net of fees (gross-of-fees return: -0.71%). For the year to date, the return net of fees is 3.58%. Since the plan's inception on November 1, 2024, the annualized return net of fees is 6.02%." No mention of the Global All-Cap Equity Index or the 2.47% comparison figure appears anywhere in the letter.
